finding: Coagulase-negative staphylococci were the most common pathogen isolated from neonates with ophthalmia neonatorum, and ophthalmia neonatorum was significantly more common in preterm infants born by lower-segment cesarean section and those requiring ventilatory support.
mod_finding: Ophthalmia neonatorum was significantly higher in preterm infants born out of lower-segment cesarean section.
